name: CorpTimer
googleShortDescription: Timers for meetings, boxing, workouts, focus and everyday routines.
description:
Make time for it with CorpTimer.

Build a meeting agenda, set up your next training session or start a quick countdown. Save your programs and come back to them whenever you need a little structure.

MEETINGS
Give every speaker a place in the agenda. Early finishes pass spare time forward; overruns reduce the time left for later turns. Pause, move to the next speaker, extend a turn and keep private notes.

WORKOUTS
Configure boxing rounds, rest, preparation and cool-down. Start from HIIT, Tabata, EMOM and AMRAP presets or customize individual rounds and sets.

FOCUS AND EVERYDAY TIMERS
Use Pomodoro focus sessions, classroom visual timers, two-player chess clocks, a stopwatch with laps, countdowns and a New Year timer with a selected time zone.

MAKE IT YOURS
Save named programs on your device. Import and export JSON setups, and export session results as CSV. Choose bundled sounds, optional in-app spoken cues and haptic feedback.

No account, ads or subscription. Programs and history stay on your device. Background alerts require notification permission and follow your phone's settings; spoken cues play while the app is open.
releaseNotes: First mobile beta: nine timer modes, editable programs, local history and import/export.
reviewNotes: No account or login required. Start from Timers. For a short transition check, edit Boxing to 2 rounds of 2 seconds work, 1 second rest and 0 seconds preparation. Native notification/device QA must be completed before using these notes for a submission.
